name: Premium Antibacterial School Socks - White
description: The best quality sock you can find in Bangladesh contains 75% 2 Ply Combed Cotton and 25% Nylon Spandex with antibacterial coating. The antibacterial property is designed and developed to inhibit or destroy the growth of microorganisms, including bacteria and fungi, which helps ward off diseases and unpleasant odors. The nylon yarn wicks sweat away from the skin into the cotton component, increasing the comfort of wearing. The soft combed cotton natural fiber provides excellent moisture control, ensuring a comfortable experience even after a long day of wear. The ankle grip technology enhances your foot's grip on the shoe to prevent internal slipping, improving agility and stability. The mesh knitting offers supreme breathability. When wet, it quickly wicks moisture away from the skin, dries extremely fast, and provides an anti-odor effect to prevent the buildup of stink, keeping feet feeling fresh.
